description: The AWESOME project deposits crop-water-demand and harvested-area scenario outputs from the WATNEEDS model for the Nile basin, with emphasis on Egypt, Ethiopia and Sudan. Its own page describes a 2011 to 2016 baseline and future windows around 2050 and 2100 under RCP2.6, RCP4.5 and RCP8.5. It says the results include blue and green crop-water requirements, irrigation consumption and harvested areas as rasters and spreadsheets inside a public ZIP. Zenodo labels the deposit CC BY 4.0 and also lists a short XLSX README and reports. Such outputs could inform irrigation-demand or water-energy-food planning simulations without rerunning WATNEEDS. The deposited item is scenario data, not the executable crop model. A limitation is that the ZIP was not downloaded, so internal file count, pixel resolution, variable units and national totals have not been verified. Round one rejected it as a single-study item; the published scenario package meets the current reuse rule. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these crop-water outputs.
